prompt.default: You work for a home care team. Plan this week's tasks for Anna (nurse) and Bas (care assistant). Read the notes on the cards: they tell you the rules. Nobody works more than 8 hours a day, and after 4 hours of work there is a break of at least 30 minutes.

planner.$comment: JSON written by the authoring mode (planner.ts): days, times, opening hours, resources, fixed blocks, tasks, the example solution and the checks; empty: the example

label.en: Show conflicts while planning (overlaps, outside opening hours)
label.nl: Botsingen tonen tijdens het plannen (overlap, buiten openingstijden)
